subject: Request for Article 30 ledger sample, pen-test summary, and KMS transfer details
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@bankcorp.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: LegalOps BankCorp <legalops@bankcorp.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Article 30 ledger sample, pen-test logs, and KMS details for onboarding

Marcus —

We're working through BankCorp's onboarding checklist for Redwood and need a few items to progress our privacy & security sign-off. Please see the items below and let me know if you can supply redacted copies or a secure channel where we can retrieve them: 

1) Article 30 ledger: sample export (schema + a small CSV excerpt) showing subprocessor categories and processing activities.
2) Penetration test summary (Q2 2026) or redacted executive summary — we do not need raw exploit data, a PDF is fine.
3) KMS architecture: whether keys are customer-managed or Redwood-managed; diagram or short note on key wrap and HSM usage.
4) Confirmation of any cross-border transfers (EU -> US) and whether standard contractual clauses or SCC equivalence are applied.

Also, our LegalOps asked whether Redwood's DPA includes a subprocessor certification annex (we may need a signed annex for our procurement). If you can flag the correct contact for DPA redlines that would help.

Target timeline: BankCorp's Privacy team hopes to complete a first review by Thu, 24 Jun. Can you confirm if that timeline is feasible?

Appreciate it — if helpful we can set a quick screen-share.

Samir
Samir Patel
Senior Security Reviewer, BankCorp
samir.patel@bankcorp.com
+1 (415) 555-1222

[Attachment requested: none attached in this message]
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@bankcorp.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Article 30 ledger sample, pen-test logs, and KMS details for onboarding

Samir —

Thanks for the clear checklist. We can provide redacted artifacts and a secure delivery. High level answers up front:
- Article 30 ledger: we can generate a CSV extract with schema + 3 example rows (redacted).
- Pen-test: we will provide a redacted executive summary (PDF) from our Q2 engagement; full report requires an NDA which we can discuss if BankCorp needs it.
- KMS: Redwood uses customer-managed keys for Dedicated/Private deployments; hosted customers use Redwood-managed keys backed by HSMs. I will include a short architecture diagram and wrap notes.
- Cross-border transfers: we use SCCs plus additional safeguards for EU->US transfers (we'll provide the clause references and the geo routing map).

About the DPA annex: Vanessa handles procurement/DPA addenda for enterprise customers; I'll loop her in for the signed subprocessor certification annex.

Timeline: Thu 24 Jun is tight but doable for the redacted artifacts. We'll send the Redacted Article 30 CSV + pen-test executive summary by EOD Wed 23 Jun and provide the KMS diagram the same day. If you need anything earlier (e.g., a quick call to confirm scope) we can do a 30-min slot tomorrow afternoon.

Deliverables we'll prepare:
- redwood_article30_excerpt.csv (3 redacted rows)
- pen_test_summary_q2_redacted.pdf
- kms_key_architecture.png
- list of subprocessors and SCC reference links

I'll attach a secure ShareFile link for the files.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Senior Privacy Manager | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
[Attachment: none in this reply — link to follow]

Marcus —

Thanks, that plan works. A couple of follow-ups from Legal/Ops: 

• SOC 2 Type II report: do you have a current SOC 2 audit we can reference, or a bridge letter?
• KMS question: if Redwood-managed keys are used for hosted customers, do you support key export logs (audit) that show cryptographic operations and key rotations? We need evidence of rotation policy and admin access logs.
• For the Article 30 extract, please ensure the "categories of processing" column maps to our template (LegalOps will send their small CSV template).

Also, LegalOps would prefer the transfer of artifacts via BankCorp-approved secure upload (ShareFile or SFTP) rather than public Drive links. Please provide credentials or an upload token for ShareFile, or let us know if Redwood will place files in a temp ShareFile folder and share.

Finally — if you can include a short note confirming whether any subprocessors are located in APAC that will store BankCorp personal data, that will help the DPIA scoping.

Samir

We're sending the artifacts to a BankCorp ShareFile folder now. Files uploaded: 
- pen_test_summary_q2_redacted.pdf (PDF, redacted exec summary)
- redwood_article30_excerpt.csv (CSV, 3 redacted rows)
- kms_key_architecture.png (PNG)

ShareFile delivery link (expires in 14 days): https://sharefile.bankcorp.com/s/secure-delivery-id-9f3a

Additional notes for LegalOps: 
• SOC 2: Redwood completed a SOC 2 Type II for the period Jan–Dec 2025; we cannot distribute the full report without a mutual NDA/ROPA exception but can provide a bridge letter and control summary in the meantime.
• KMS logging: for Redwood-managed keys we provide audit logs that capture key use events and rotation records; those logs are retained for 12 months by default and can be exported for audit on request. For Dedicated/Private customers with customer-managed KMS we provide role-based access logs (admin audit) as part of provisioning.
• Subprocessor APAC presence: one analytics subprocessor (thirdparty-analytics.com) operates in APAC and may process metadata for hosted customers; we have added this to the Article 30 excerpt row and noted locations in the CSV.

Next steps: Vanessa will follow up re: DPA annex (procurement redlines) and can coordinate countersignature logistics. If BankCorp wants a 30-min DPIA kickoff, we are available Thu 25 Jun 10:00–12:00 PT.

Regards,
Irene Choi
